text:
Asha K: stepping off in 10m — switching primary to Miguel R and secondary to Priya S for the midnight bridge. Before I go, quick pass on perms: PagerDuty, AWS console assume-role, Grafana dashboard + alert edits. callouts below, pls confirm you can do these. :wave:
Miguel R: got it. I'll verify now. if anything's missing, i can escalate but should be ok.
Priya S: on standby, lemme know if you want me to take pages during the APAC gap.
Asha K: thanks. checklist i'm running through — share results here so it's auditable:
```
# PagerDuty
1) can you access the Redwood production schedule? pd schedules list | grep prod
2) can you trigger a test page to your phone? pd incidents trigger --service prod-api --priority high --summary "test page"
# AWS
1) aws sts get-caller-identity
2) aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallAccess --role-session-name oncall-check
# Grafana
1) open https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/production/overview
2) verify Alerts -> Alert Rules -> prod-high-latency is visible and you can mute/unmute
```
Miguel R: PagerDuty: can see schedule and on-call rotation. tried test page — phone dinged. pd shows me as primary for tonight. :thumbsup:
Miguel R: AWS: sts identity OK:
```
{
  "UserId": "AROAEXAMPLE",
  "Account": "123456789012",
  "Arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/miguel"
}
```
Miguel R: assume-role works but note: MFA prompt for console, so if you try to access via SSO you'll get the SAML MFA step.
Miguel R: Grafana: can view dashboards and mute alerts. can't edit alert rule config (needs grafana-admin role) — but we can mute and ack incidents. added note: edit perms are not required for oncall unless changing thresholds.
Priya S: PagerDuty: i can see both the schedule and incidents. test page went to mobile + pager.
Priya S: AWS: i can assume-role via cli but console access times out for me intermittently — might be a session duration/SSO issue. tried `aws sts assume-role` output below:
```
{ "AssumedRoleUser": { "AssumedRoleId": "AROASAMPLE:session", "Arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/OncallAccess/session" }, "Credentials": { "AccessKeyId": "ASIAEXAMPLE", "SecretAccessKey": "...", "SessionToken": "...", "Expiration": "2026-03-16T03:45:00Z" } }
```
Priya S: tagging ops-bot for help on SSO session reliability.
ops-bot: @Priya S — opened ticket INC-2026-433: Investigate SSO session timeouts for oncall sessions (linked to identity provider). Escalation path: if you can't assume-role during a page, follow runbook step 2b to use emergency key fallback (stored in 1Password under Secrets/Oncall/EmergencyAccess). :warning:
Asha K: good call. Priya — pls try the emergency fallback now and confirm you can get the minimal console view (cloudwatch logs) — don't share creds here.
Priya S: used emergency fallback, can view CloudWatch logs and tail Lambda logs. confirmed.
Jules V: quick ops note — APAC early shift gap from 00:00-04:00 UTC tomorrow has only one primary listed. we should assign a backup or handover to oncall rotation to avoid a lone primary during low hours.
Asha K: agreed. Miguel, can you and Priya coordinate to cover 00-02 UTC and maybe swap with Jules covering 02-04?
Miguel R: yes i can cover 00-02. Priya you good for 02-04?
Priya S: i can do 02-04 but prefer to be secondary for the midnight spike window.
Asha K: updated runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood/c/ops/oncall-runbook — see section "Access sanity checks" and subsection "PagerDuty quick tests". copying the minimal steps here for convenience:
- PagerDuty: Confirm your name appears under the active on-call schedule. Trigger a test page.
- AWS: `aws sts get-caller-identity` and then `aws sts assume-role --role-arn <OncallRole>` — if CLI fails, use 1Password emergency access.
- Grafana: verify dashboard load, mute/ack alert rule. If graphs don't load, try disabling ad-blocker or using VPN to internal.
Sam T: small addition — for notifications, make sure your PagerDuty contact methods include at least one SMS and one push. we had an incident where mobile push didn't arrive because the user had background app refresh off.
oncall-bot: Incident reminder: scheduled oncall rotation for prod-api starts 2026-03-16T00:00Z. If coverage changes, update the schedule via PD or ping #eng-schedule.
Miguel R: all set from me. I have PD test, can assume role, can mute alerts. leaving a note in the schedule for coverage swap. :white_check_mark:
Priya S: emergency fallback verified, will be secondary 00-02 then primary 02-04 as discussed.
Asha K: thanks team — i'm signing off now. = leaving bridge link in case of escalation: https://zoom.redwood/rooms/oncall-midnight. If anything blocks, raise INC and tag @eng-oncall. :raised_hands:
